request.query: Register as a resident and get a Finnish personal identity code (DVV)

sources.title: ihhelsinki.fi
highlights: Newcomers moving to Finland need to register their data into the Finnish Population Information system at the Digital and Population Data Services Agency (DVV
At International House Helsinki (IHH), the Digital and Population Data Services Agency (DVV) issues personal identity codes and registers personal data into the Finnish Population Information System

sources.title: dvv.fi
highlights: Everyone who requests a personal identity code must visit in person within 1 month of submitting the form, including children
a valid passport or an official photo ID card of a citizen from an EU member country, Iceland, Norway, Liechtenstein, Switzerland, or San Marino
a residence permit card or any other possible proof that you are residing legally in Finland
proof of work or studies in Finland, for example, a certificate of student status or an employment contract (employee, check your right to work
Finnish identity code request (work, study) 2–3 weeks

sources.title: finlandhandbook.com
highlights: You might find that the first available slot for identity verification is three weeks away, and only after that does the 1–3 week processing clock begin
If you have the flexibility to travel, sometimes booking an appointment at a DVV office in a smaller town like Porvoo, Lahti, or even further afield can shave weeks off your wait for an appointment
If you submit your request in August or early September, expect the DVV processing times to stretch toward the 4-to-6-week mark

sources.title: nordicexpat.com
highlights: Appointments at the busy Helsinki-area locations can fill up, so book as early as you can rather than leaving it to the end of the one-month window
If family registration matters to you, check DVV's document requirements in advance — this is the single most common cause of a wasted appointment

sources.title: nordicexpat.com
highlights: Book as early as you can; if slots are scarce, check service points in nearby municipalities and the booking system at different times of day
